adr: ADR-160 D7 — a medium is a named record, and a force model declares what it needs
what: ONE COMMITTED DATA ROW PER MEDIUM. D3 forbids a cross-package runtime import, so each lab implements the media it can answer for in its own language — but a lab may differ only in what it can ANSWER, never in what a medium's properties ARE. This file is the values half. It is deliberately dependency-free JSON so a cross-package drift test (ADR-160 S5) can read it beside aero-lab's Python atmosphere constants and ocean-lab's TypeScript seawater constants and fail when any of them disagree.
notWhat: Not a solver, not an answer machine, and not a claim that this lab resolves a column. The `implementation` block on each row states exactly what THIS lab answers; `properties` is the shared half a drift test compares.

units.gravityMps2: m/s^2, a vector in the plant's world frame (x, y, z), z up
units.dynamicViscosityPaS: Pa*s — dynamic, because that is what an atmosphere model produces (mu_Pas). Kinematic viscosity is mu/rho and is DERIVED, never stored here (D7)
units.speedOfSoundMs: m/s, null when the medium cannot answer — never defaulted
units.temperatureK: K, null when the medium cannot answer — never defaulted
units.heightM: metres above the medium's own datum, positive up. The validity coordinate.

earthSurfaceGravitySource: The value this package has always written into its MJCF <option> (engine/physics/mjcf.ts G_MPS2). Standard gravity rounded to three figures. ISA's g0 = 9.80665 in aero-lab's atmosphere.py is a DIFFERENT quantity — the geopotential reference constant its pressure law is built on — not a second answer to the plant's gravity.

vacuum.label: Vacuum (Earth surface gravity)
vacuum.summary: What this package's drone plant has always run in without saying so: gravity, mass and contact, no fluid at all.

validity.why: Gravity is the only property a rigid body takes from this medium, and dg/dh = -2g/R_earth = -3.09e-6 s^-2, so 9.81 holds to 3.1e-4 relative over +/-1000 m of the datum. Outside that band this row would be extrapolating a constant it has no basis for, and it refuses instead.

provenance.densityKgM3: Zero by definition — a vacuum. ADR-160 D7: 'Vacuum is trivial: density zero, no field, no free surface'.
provenance.dynamicViscosityPaS: Zero by definition. Kinematic viscosity mu/rho is 0/0 and is therefore UNAVAILABLE rather than zero — asking for it is medium_property_unavailable.

air.label: Air (ISA sea level)
air.summary: Standard-atmosphere air at the sea-level station. aero-lab resolves the whole column; this lab answers one station and says so.

field.why: This lab models no wind. A still field is an answer, not a silent zero: its velocity and its gradient are both identically zero everywhere and it says so by name. aero-lab's WindField.sample -> WindSample (engine/aerosim/env/wind.py) is the resolving implementation; ADR-160 D7 names it as the seed shape and D3 forbids importing it across packages.

validity.why: THIS LAB'S CHOSEN BAND, stated as a choice: a constant sea-level density is within about 1 % over the surface layer +/-100 m, and this lab does not resolve the column, so it refuses outside rather than extrapolating. The authoritative band is aero-lab's atmosphere, valid over [-5000, 47000] m and raising outside it (engine/aerosim/env/atmosphere.py ALTITUDE_MIN_M / ALTITUDE_MAX_M, and env/__init__.py's own note that it RAISES rather than clamping).

provenance.densityKgM3: 1.2250 kg/m^3 — the sea-level entry of aero-lab's own ISA validation table, engine/aerosim/env/atmosphere.py (the (0.0, 1.2250) reference pair it checks itself against, repeated at integrate.py's reference chain).
provenance.dynamicViscosityPaS: Sutherland's law at T = 288.15 K with aero-lab's own committed constants: mu = SUTHERLAND_C1_PA_S_PER_SQRT_K * T^1.5 / (T + SUTHERLAND_S_K) = 1.458e-6 * 288.15^1.5 / (288.15 + 110.4) = 1.7893802780775830e-05 Pa*s, carried here to six significant figures.
provenance.speedOfSoundMs: a = sqrt(GAMMA_AIR * R_AIR_J_PER_KG_K * T) = sqrt(1.4 * (8314.32 / 28.9644) * 288.15) = 340.2941077869353 m/s, from the same module's constants. aeropolar.py writes the same number rounded as 340.29.
provenance.gravityMps2: earthSurfaceGravityMps2 above — gravity is a property of the place, not of the fluid, so all three Earth-surface rows carry the same vector.

seawater.label: Seawater (coastal)
seawater.summary: Constant-density coastal seawater. ocean-lab resolves the column and carries a free surface with wave and current fields; this lab carries NEITHER, which is why a flotation question in this medium is a refusal rather than a number.

field.why: This lab models neither wave nor current. ocean-lab's marine and rotor-design engines carry those; D3 forbids importing them, and a still field states the absence by name instead of pretending to a sea state.

validity.why: Fully submerged seawater, measured down from the datum. There is no free surface in this row, so the medium has no answer at all above the datum and refuses there; 1000 m is this lab's chosen floor, below which a constant-density row with no pressure law has no business answering.

provenance.densityKgM3: 1025 kg/m^3 — ocean-lab's own committed constant SEAWATER_DENSITY_KGM3. It is declared TWICE inside that package (src-routes/engine/marine/services/power-budget.ts:32 and src-routes/engine/rotor-design/services/rotor-presets.ts:26); ADR-160 D8 names that duplication as the disease, and this row is the single value both of those must agree with. It is also the density the autonomous-explorer design study used: its published 24.1 L float displacement giving 24.7 kg of buoyancy is 0.0241 m^3 * 1025 kg/m^3 = 24.7025 kg.
provenance.dynamicViscosityPaS: DERIVED, once, from ocean-lab's two committed constants: mu = rho * nu = 1025 kg/m^3 * 1.05e-6 m^2/s (SEAWATER_KINEMATIC_VISCOSITY_M2S, src-routes/engine/rotor-design/services/section-polar.ts:33) = 1.07625e-3 Pa*s exactly. Stored dynamic because D7 says dynamic is what a medium carries; nu comes back out as mu/rho.
provenance.speedOfSoundMs: null — neither ocean-lab nor this lab carries one, and D7 forbids defaulting a property a medium cannot answer.
provenance.temperatureK: null — ocean-lab's constants are labelled 'coastal temperature and salinity' without committing to a temperature, so there is nothing to carry.

checks: seawater.properties.densityKgM3 == ocean-lab SEAWATER_DENSITY_KGM3 in BOTH src-routes/engine/marine/services/power-budget.ts and src-routes/engine/rotor-design/services/rotor-presets.ts
